product_metadata.title: Afloia HEPA Air Purifier for Pets, Air Purifiers for Home Large Room Up to 880 Ft², H13 True HEPA Filter Air Cleaner for Home Remove 99.99% Pets Hair Odor Dust Smoke Mold Pollen, Fillo Black
features: 🍀Improve air quality: With imported 3 stage HEPA H13 filters, Afloia air purifier filters air 4x per hour in 220 sq feet, remove 99.99% of pet dander, dust, pollen, smoke, odor, mold, etc. Effectively improving indoor air quality. It only takes an hour to purify a 880 ft² room.

🍀Help with allergies: Afloia air purifier is a great solution for people with allergies and asthma. It helps ease sneezing, headaches, congestion, and other allergy symptoms caused by airborne contaminants such as dust and pollen.

🍀Pet families friendly: Afloia air purifier is a must-have for pet owners. It helps eliminate pet odors, hair, and dander, keeping the air in your house fresh and clean. It's a great way to keep allergies at bay.

🍀Various rooms use: With low/medium/high wind speeds and a 2/4/8-hour timer function, you can customize different wind speed and time for your bedroom, living room, office, and kitchen based on the room area.

🍀Multiple Filter Choices: Please replace with Afloia filter element every 4-6 months to get better purifying effect(up to the air quality in your area). B087TT2N14:Original Filter; B09VPS21KC: Pet Allergy Filter; B09WYSZ331:Antibacterial Filter. You can search ASIN on Amazon to get replacement filters you want.

details.Care instructions: Replace the filter element 4-6 months, Not washable
